recentItems.title: ICYMI: Reaksyon ni Raffy sa hindi pagsagot ni Boransing sa mga tanong niya
recentItems.description:
In case you missed it (September 1, 2026): Napa-react si senator-judge Raffy Tulfo matapos makailang-ulit na hindi sagutin ng testigong si AFP Col. Manaros Boransing II, sa impeachment trial ni Vice Presdient Sara Duterte ang mga tanong nito kaugnay ng pagtiyak ng seguridad at kaligtasan ng bise sa mga aktibidad na dinaluhan nito at ng DepEd.

Sa huli, sinagot ni Boransing ang tanong ng senador. Aniya, mas nakatuon ang kanilang proteksyon, hindi lang sa mga VIPs tulad ng bise, kundi sa mga estudyanteng dumadalo sa mga nasabing aktibidad.

recentItems.title: ICYMI: Tanong ni Cayetano na hinarang ni Chiz, itinanong niya kalaunan kay Poa | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
In case you missed it (September 2, 2026): Sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte noong Miyerkoles, muling itinanong ni senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano sa testigong si Atty. Michael Poa ang tanong na una niyang ibinato sa prosekusyon ngunit hinarang ni presiding officer Chiz Escudero isang araw bago nito.

Ang tanong ng senador, sumentro sa kung ano ang pagkakaiba ng "irregular," "illegal," at "unlawful" pagdating sa paggastos o pag-disburse ng confidential funds, alinsunod sa joint circular ng Commission on Audit.

Sa huli, muli rin itong itinanong ng senador sa prosekusyon.

recentItems.title: ICYMI: Sotto, may pa-blind item sa gov’t agency na nagkaroon ng P125-M confidential funds
recentItems.description:
In case you missed it (September 3, 2026): Sa pagdinig ng Senate Committee on Finance, may pasaring si Senate President Pro Tempore Tito Sotto sa ahensiya ng gobyerno na nagkaroon umano ng P125M na confidential funds nang limang beses.

Ito ay sa gitna ng deliberasyon ng komite kaugnay ng budget ng Office of the Ombudsman kung saan humihingi ito ng karagdagang P54M para sa sarili nitong confidential funds.

"A drop in the bucket kung tutuusin for what the work the Ombudsman is doing. As a matter of fact, there is one office, one office of government that had P125M five times, eh. 'Di ba? For confidential funds," hirit ni Sotto.

recentItems.title: Environmental groups call for cross-border accountability over haze in Indonesia
recentItems.description:
Malaysian environmental groups protested outside the Indonesian embassy in Kuala Lumpur on Friday (September 4), urging Jakarta to disclose evidence identifying Malaysian-linked companies allegedly associated with fires and haze in Indonesia.

Activists led by Greenpeace demanded the release of concession maps, hotspot data, and fire investigation findings, as well as the public naming of the identified companies, so that Malaysian regulators, lawmakers, and civil society groups could pursue accountability.

"I hope that Anwar Ibrahim, the Prime Minister (of Malaysia), get in touch with Prabowo Subianto, work with him, and get the details, the data, the analysis, the names of the companies who are actively engaged and contributing to the open fire in Kalimantan, in Sumatra, and Indonesia in general. These companies need to be called and need to be penalized and prosecuted," said Malaysian Advocacy Group (HARAM) Chairman Brendon Gan.

They also called for Indonesia to share evidence with Malaysia through ASEAN or bilateral channels, and for both countries to investigate companies based in their respective jurisdictions.

Sarawak, which borders Indonesian Kalimantan on Borneo, has been worst hit by the haze. As of 12 p.m. local time, Serian district recorded a hazardous Air Pollutant Index reading of 518, while unhealthy levels were reported in 2 districts across Sarawak, environment department data showed.

(Camera, Editing, Production: Mandy Leong Huey Mun)
